sections.label: Mental health youth conversation
sections.summary: Mental health drew over 2,100 votes, ninth among top topics, leading to a face-to-face Youth Conversation with HPB whose insights went to agencies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The topic of mental health received over 2,100 votes, making it the ninth among the top topics of interest, ranging from social inequality to marriage and parenthood.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: A face-to-face Youth Conversation was subsequently organised in partnership with the Health Promotion Board (HPB), bringing students, volunteers, and mental health professionals together to discuss what more we can do as a society.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Following the session, youths’ insights and ideas were shared with various Government agencies, including HPB, the Agency for Integrated Care and the National Council for Social Services.

sections.label: Youth mental health projects funded
sections.summary: Youths started SOAR, Youth Corps began a mental health cluster, and the National Youth Fund and Young ChangeMakers Grant funded youth-led projects.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: In addition, two participants came together to start a project called the School of Ability and Recovery (SOAR) Initiative to foster mental wellness and reduce stigma through education.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Youth Corps Singapore recently started a mental health cluster which will facilitate youth leaders in galvanising like-minded volunteers to do more in this area.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Through the National Youth Fund and Young ChangeMakers Grant, we funded projects led by youths and Youth Sector Organisations, such as the Singapore Mental Health Film Festival by Breathe Movement, held in February this year, which aimed to increase awareness about the complexity of mental illnesses through a series of films and panel discussions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Through these efforts, we complement the Ministry of Health's wider initiatives to improve mental well-being, as part of the recommendations under the NurtureSG Action Plan and Community Mental Health Masterplan.

sections.label: Initiatives reach broad spectrum youths
sections.summary: Initiatives under the National Youth Council and Youth Corps are not limited to students and reach a broad spectrum of youths, including young working adults.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The initiatives under the National Youth Council and Youth Corps are not limited to students.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: So, actually, they reach out to a broad spectrum of youths, including young working adults.
